F1_conditional_label_value_wrap_spacing.rule: First lay out F1 P3-P6 as the Addendum-01 single inline label/value flow with no added gap. If and only if the first rendered value fragment begins on a lower line than the final rendered label fragment, shift the entire value span downward by 0.75u using relative positioning and add 0.75u bottom padding to that P-block so following content cannot overlap. Re-measure after the adjustment. Do not change width, text, line breaks, font size, weight, tracking or block gap to trigger or avoid the condition.
F1_conditional_label_value_wrap_spacing.rationale: This makes the parent F1 '0.75u within label/value blocks' phrase executable without forcing a wrap or changing source text.
